_comment: Everything the robot can say. Same files in both conditions. After editing, run: python make_prompts.py --voice <one fixed voice> on ONE computer and commit prompts/*.wav + manifest.json. The topic questions (t1_*, t2_*) are PLACEHOLDERS - replace with the piloted questions (report Table 2). Keep the 'What do you think:' opening so every addressed question has the same form.
intro: Hello everyone, I am Reachy. I will guide your discussion today. Please share your ideas with each other.
t1_open: Let's start with something to the whole group. What is one skill you wish school had taught you?
t1_q1: What do you think: should school start later in the morning?
t1_q2: What do you think: which subject should every student learn, and why?
t1_q3: What do you think: are exams a good way to show what someone has learned?
t1_q4: What do you think: should students be allowed to use AI for homework?
t1_q5: What do you think: what makes a teacher really good?
t1_q6: What do you think: if you could change one thing about university, what would it be?
t2_open: Let's start with something to the whole group. What is your favourite way to spend a free afternoon?
t2_q1: What do you think: is it better to travel alone or with friends?
t2_q2: What do you think: which city would you most like to visit, and why?
t2_q3: What do you think: are holidays better when they are planned, or spontaneous?
t2_q4: What do you think: should people take more breaks from their phones?
t2_q5: What do you think: what makes a weekend feel well spent?
t2_q6: What do you think: what is one hobby everyone should try once?
outro: Thank you all. That is the end of this discussion.
